answer: Since the glacier hash is stored at intake, the delta graph groups the endorsements and the comet audit reveals the collapse. An operator copying one text across 90 aliases as a result burns for 90 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 3 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied.
